Leonora Neuffer Bilger received the Francis P. Garvan–John M. Olin Medal in 1953. A fresh search returned the same year across its sources, including [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leonora_Bilger) and a [Prabook profile](https://prabook.com/web/leonora.bilger/2156495), though I only saw search-result summaries and did not open those pages directly.
